answer: Reaching eligibility takes 90 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. The sparrow register is checked at draw time, signal lists the eligible set, and marble seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 90 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 409 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
